title: ProcedureRecord
description: Canonical identity of one administrative procedure (one of the ~38 in the corpus). This is the object the exact-string shortcut and dense retrieval both resolve queries down to (Section 8).

procedure_id.description: Stable unique identifier, e.g. 'PROC-014'. Referenced by ProcedureFragment.procedure_id and by EvidenceBundle.resolved_procedure_id.

canonical_name.description: The official Vietnamese name of the procedure, as used in the source law/decree.

aliases.description: Known alternate names, abbreviations, and colloquial phrasings that map to this procedure. Consulted by the exact-string shortcut (Section 8.1) before falling through to embedding-based retrieval.

official_codes.description: Any official procedure codes assigned by the issuing authority.

jurisdiction.description: The administrative jurisdiction this procedure applies to (e.g. a province, or 'national').

fragment_ids.description: IDs of every ProcedureFragment belonging to this procedure. Kept here so a resolved procedure_id can be expanded to its full set of fields without a separate query.

source_id.description: ID of the SourceManifest this procedure's definition was extracted from.
